injects.title: Initial Earthquake Impact Report
injects.description: M7.4 earthquake struck at 06:30. Multiple reports of building collapses in Batagram City. Communication lines partially disrupted. District administration requesting immediate federal assistance.

injects.title: Aftershock M5.8
injects.description: A magnitude 5.8 aftershock has caused secondary collapses in Batagram City center. Rescue teams report additional casualties. Building safety becomes critical concern.

injects.title: KKH Road Blocked
injects.description: Karakoram Highway blocked at 4 points due to massive landslides between Mansehra and Batagram. No road access to district. Air support requested for reconnaissance.

injects.title: Telecom Network Outage
injects.description: Major fiber-optic backbone cut between Abbottabad and Batagram. Cell towers down in 80% of the district. Emergency satellite communication deployment needed for NEOC.

injects.title: Massive Debris in Main Hospital
injects.description: DHQ Batagram courtyard is overwhelmed with casualties. Debris blocking access to emergency ward. Urgent engineering support for site clearance and makeshift structure stabilization.

injects.title: NEOC ICT System Failure
injects.description: NEOC server racks in Batagram damaged by dust and power surges. Internal coordination dashboard is offline. Emergency maintenance required for critical comms hardware.

injects.title: Potable Water Crisis
injects.description: Natural springs in Alai region contaminated by landslide debris. Reports of diarrheal cases in displacement clusters. Urgent water purification and BOWSER deployment requested.

injects.title: International SAR Support
injects.description: Three international Urban SAR teams (INSARAG classified) have arrived with specialized equipment. Integration into the Sectorized SAR plan required.

injects.title: Landslide Risk on Alai-Batagram Link
injects.description: Geological assessment indicates imminent slope failure on primary relief route to Alai. Convoy safety compromised. Alternative route or stabilization needed.

injects.title: Tarbela Dam Seismic Audit
injects.description: WAPDA reports minor technical anomalies in pressure sensors at Tarbela following a M5.2 aftershock. Joint engineering audit team requested for on-site verification.

injects.title: Satellite Comms Maintenance
injects.description: Satellite link at Forward Operational Base (FOB) showing degradation. Critical for coordinating airlift operations. Tech E&M team needed for uplink realignment.

injects.title: Permanent Shelter Planning
injects.description: Displaced population analysis shows 45,000 houses permanently uninhabitable. Plans wing required to initiate strategic donor briefing for reconstruction funding.

injects.title: Safe School Rebuilding Standards
injects.description: Education department mandates 'Zone 4' seismic compliance for all new school structures. Engineering protocols needed for transitional learning centers.

injects.title: Digital Compensation Registry
injects.description: Liaison with commercial banks for biometric compensation disbursement. Tech E&M to ensure data link stability at district hubs for smooth processing.

injects.title: Reconstruction Cost Master Plan
injects.description: Detailed engineering audit finalized for 1,200 public buildings. Estimated budget PKR 95 billion for resilience-weighted reconstruction. Submission to Finance Division.

injects.title: After-Action Report: Technical Systems
injects.description: NIDM coordinating comprehensive review of NEOC technical performance. Audit of communication redundancies and digital coordination efficiency during the crisis.

injects.title: Project Development Finalization
injects.description: 50 high-priority bridge and road reconstruction projects approved for donor funding. Structural standards finalized to withstand M8.0 events.
